annotations.title: Get a number's contact quota for this billing cycle

description:
Check how much of this number's contact allowance is left.

A contact counts once per billing cycle when this number messages them
through Turbo Notify, new **or** returning. Messaging the same person
again in a later cycle counts again.

Like the message quota, this is per number rather than per organization,
and it resets at `cycle_end`.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
